tweaks.name: Ask about audience and goal first
Color is never the only signal
Link text says where it goes
Don't ask twice for the same data
No entrance animation on every render
Skip enter animation on first paint
Motion not sole way to operate
No surprise on focus or input
Review before legal or financial submit
Custom controls expose name, role, value
No cognitive test to log in
Don't rely on title for labels
Reserve space for embeds and ads
Row actions on hover and focus
Apply one tweak at a time
